title: Chapter 1398
text:
"You said that not only did you sense the opportunity to ascend, but the Soul Swapper also mutated, causing your psychic power to mutate?"

In the private workshop, Han Xiao turned around and looked at Fu Ding with a strange expression.

"That's right, I was also very surprised. My Soul Connection has increased by a level, and part of the Soul Swapper's characteristics have been added to my psychic power. Also, I vaguely sensed the existence of a secondary dimension, and my intuition guided me there."

Fu Ding shook his head helplessly.

… What's with that helpless expression of yours? You think it's troublesome to have a fortuitous encounter? Is this what it means to be the pride of the heavens?

Han Xiaoxin complained in his mind and pondered.

Speaking of which, he had used (Bold Explorer) to look at the origin of the Soul Swapper before. It was not that rare and was a man-made product. However, it might have formed a connection with a certain secondary dimension when it mutated into a Space Wonder.

He guessed that once a person qualified to ascend to the Beyond Grade A realm, they would be able to activate this hidden benefit. The possibility was quite high.

It was no wonder that the Soul Swapper was so eager for Fu Ding's favor. It turned out that it saw an opportunity to unlock its new position on Fu Ding.

Han Xiaoxin injected Fu Ding with a needle while he was at it. The main reason Fu Ding came over to report was to receive his' physical examination '.

After the needle was inserted, the combat information popped up on the interface.

Han Xiao took a look and realized that Fu Ding had a new energy attribute that involved the soul. At the same time, he had two new talents. One was the new bonus from the Soul Swapper, which increased his psychic power and a series of attributes. The other talent was a question mark and was still in a gray frozen state.

A person sitting at home and a talent coming from the sky … Tsk, what kind of world is this?

Han Xiao felt sour in his heart. He coughed dryly and said,

"Since your intuition guided you to that secondary dimension, you should go and take a look. Is the guidance you received a direction or specific coordinates?"

"Coordinates." Fu Ding nodded in response.

"Oh, that's convenient. We don't have to spend too much time on the road. However, most people have a sense of direction. Your coordinates should be the hidden information record of the Soul Swapper. Let me pack up and we'll set off."

With that said, Han Xiao prepared to put away the technology in his hands and summon the vehicle.

But at this moment, Fu Ding shook his head, expressing his refusal.

"Black Star, I have a feeling that this is my personal training. If you follow me, I won't feel any danger. I'll go alone."

Han Xiao paused and muttered to himself.

"Since that's what you want, that's fine. I'll give you a set of Kings, and you can bring another set of Thrones. If you encounter any problems that you can't solve, just ask me for help …"

Seeing that Fu Ding still wanted to say something, Han Xiao waved his hand and interrupted him.

"You're my good friend. I can't let you take the risk without any backup. This is my bottom line."

"… Alright then." Fu Ding smiled helplessly.

Han Xiao took out the corresponding equipment and a small vehicle specially used for secondary dimensions, letting the mechanical assistant bring it to the departure point. After Fu Ding thanked him, he followed along.

Watching Fu Ding's back disappear, Han Xiao looked away and shook his head lightly.

To a Calamity Grade, the secondary dimension was still quite dangerous. Han Xiao was worried about Fu Ding's safety and originally wanted to accompany him. However, the other party wanted to clear the dungeon alone, which involved the opportunity to ascend to a Beyond Grade A, so he respected Fu Ding's premonition.

However, with Fu Ding's luck, no matter what danger he encountered, he would most likely be able to turn it into a blessing. If he added his luck black hole, there might be some twists and turns. It would be a good thing if he did not go.

However, Han Xiao would not sit back and watch this baby of his be in danger. Just now, he had secretly placed an Observer's Mark on Fu Ding and was prepared to monitor the risk. After all, Fu Ding had the coordinates, and unlike Harrison, it would not take him much time.

Han Xiao turned around and glanced at the research instrument that was analyzing the new technology. He temporarily froze the progress and stopped it.

Every Beyond Grade A had their own training plan. Han Xiao had brought out more blueprints from the Sanctum this time. During this time, he mainly studied these technologies and refreshed his attributes. In the words of a Mechanic, this was called optimizing the allocation of resources, piling up attribute points in places where they were more cost-effective. Many little drops made an ocean, and it could also increase his combat strength.

After entering the First Sanctum this time, his authority had increased to level 9, and his memory capacity had increased again. Furthermore, the empty marks on the message board of the Sanctum had also decreased. However, the last few paragraphs of content were still empty.

Last time, the valuable information of 'Information Form Stripping Plan' had appeared in the fourth last paragraph, but this time, the last paragraph had attracted his attention. Han Xiao could not help but recall.

… The route of the previous Iteration's plan should have been correct, but it failed due to some loopholes. We have decided to add a control valve to the Iteration's device to reduce the cost of dealing with the rampaging of the Iteration. However, I don't know what form the control valve will take after the Iteration's mutation …

During the days he left the Sanctum, he had been pondering over this piece of information. It seemed like the previous Iteration had agreed with the plan of the previous Iteration and made improvements on the foundation.

Generally speaking, civilizations facing the Great Reboot would not completely place their hopes on the route of their predecessors. After all, the failures of their predecessors had already shown that their respective plans were not good, and they could only provide some lessons.

However, the previous Iteration was actually willing to believe in the plan of the previous Iteration. If not for the fact that this plan had some merit, the subsequent civilizations would not have made such a decision. In that case, this plan that had been improved for two Iterations was very valuable, and Han Xiao secretly took it to heart.

"I'll have to enter the First Sanctum a few more times in the future. I wonder how high my authority will be to unlock these two latest messages."

Han Xiao calmed himself down, left the workshop, and returned to the office on the top floor. He first looked down at the combat training of the other Calamity Grades before entering the vision of the Observer's Mark.

…

At the private dock, mechanical assistants entered and exited the small carrier, quickly completing the debugging.

Fu Ding sat in the pilot's seat, recalled for a moment, and entered the secondary dimension coordinates into the navigation device. He then started the shuttle engine, and immediately felt the spaceship vibrate slightly.

"Locking onto secondary dimension coordinates … Warming up shuttle engine … Activating internal space stabilization device …"

The artificial intelligence of the spaceship kept broadcasting, and a large number of navigation parameters appeared on the operation screen.

Fu Ding set the autopilot, took out the Soul Swapper, and pressed it to his chest. He then took a deep breath and slowly calmed himself down.

Not long after, the spaceship completed its pre-flight self-check, and the vibration suddenly disappeared. Fu Ding felt his body suddenly become heavy, as if he was pushed back into his seat by a strong force. The scene of the dock outside the window also shattered in an instant, turning into endless streams of light. The spaceship had officially entered the shuttle state.

After an unknown period of time, the spaceship shook again and exited the shuttle state. The scene outside changed.

This was a pitch-black space with no boundaries. An incalculably large gray nebula vortex slowly rotated outside the window, located above the spaceship. He looked up, but he could not see the full appearance of the vortex at all. He could not help but be shocked.

At the center of the vortex, an enormous white beam of light shot out, extending out of sight. He did not know where the end was.

At the same time, wisps of gray air constantly drifted in from all directions, attracted by the nebula vortex. They all merged into it like rivers flowing into the sea. This was the main material that made up this vortex.

Before Fu Ding could exclaim, he discovered something strange. In this space, his mental strength seemed to have become more active, and the Soul Swapper was also vibrating slightly. He did not know what this meant.

"What is this place …"

Fu Ding looked around. There did not seem to be any signs of life around him. He released his psychic power, which was too active and difficult to control, and captured a gray air flow that passed by him to see what it was made of.

After carefully investigating, Fu Ding's expression suddenly changed, revealing a look of shock.

"This is … a soul?"

He suddenly turned his head and looked at the endless gray air flow, his eyes full of disbelief.

This nebula vortex was actually made up of souls?

At this time, Fu Ding suddenly thought of a piece of information and muttered to himself,

"In the imagination of some psychic ability users, when a living being dies, the soul seems to have completely dissipated, but in reality, there are still unobservable fragments left. Some of them turn into psychic undercurrents, while the other part drifts in the universe.

There should be such places in this world that accept wandering soul fragments from the entire universe, filter them, crush them, and extract the remnant thoughts inside, condense them into a universal consciousness, and continue to sink into the 'bottom level of the sub-consciousness' dimension. Some psychic ability users call such places' Soul Terminal ',' Spirit World Temple ', and' Ultimate Ruins'.

However, no one has ever found a similar secondary dimension. Could it be that the legends are real? "

Fu Ding had a look of surprise. The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was one of the legendary 'Soul Terminals'.

During the development of the Flickering World, Black Star had taken a group of officers to travel around, and Fu Ding had once been lucky enough to see a Heart Sucking Demon from the 'bottom level of the sub-consciousness' dimension. He had turned it into his own nutrients and strengthened his psychic power, so he had paid special attention to theories in this area.

The three Universal Civilizations knew the coordinates of the bottom level of the sub-consciousness dimension, but the endless Heart Sucking Demons were there, and they were extremely xenophobic. With the current technology, it was very difficult to build a stable outpost there.

The Heart Sucking Demons fed on the sub-consciousness of the universe, so the Soul Terminal was equivalent to their kitchen. The soul fragments here were all unprocessed 'ingredients'.

"The Soul Swapper actually led me here. Could it be related to this dimension?"

Fu Ding thought to himself.

The effect of the Soul Swapper had long exceeded its initial imagination. Perhaps it had mutated into a Universal Treasure because of the Soul Terminal, which was why the Soul Swapper had such a strange effect …

After guessing for a while, Fu Ding carefully sensed the gray aura around him and smiled bitterly.

These gray streams of air were the remnants of souls, and the center of the nebula vortex was constantly refining the remnants and "serving" them.

The Heart Sucking Demon was a great tonic for the mind, but the side effects would take a lot of time to resolve.

These soul fragments were even more impure. Although he could absorb the soul energy to refine his mental strength, most of his energy had to be used to resolve the side effects of schizophrenia and personality disorder.

Furthermore, the small amount of energy contained in the soul fragments was almost undetectable to his mental strength. The conversion efficiency was extremely low, and the input far exceeded the output.

As for the universe's sub-consciousness after the refinement, soul energy had already been removed. Not only were the side effects even more violent, it was not beneficial to him at all.

"Speaking of which, this place is quite suitable for Hella. Her Power of the Dead can quickly purify soul energy. This might be her cultivation holy land …"

Fu Ding muttered to himself. Suddenly, he was stunned.

He had almost forgotten that he had the Soul Swapper. If the target was only the soul fragments, the Soul Swapper should be able to separate the remnant thoughts and soul energy and refine them, right?

Doesn't that mean that I can also absorb these countless soul fragments without any side effects?

Fu Ding instantly understood and was overjoyed.

Could this be the reason why the Soul Swapper led me here?

If I cultivate here for a period of time, there's an 80% chance that I can advance. My intuition is not lying. This is indeed an opportunity to advance!

…

"Amazing …"

On the other side, Han Xiao's mouth twitched. He had mixed feelings.

I thought that I was already very powerful with my cheat code. Who would have thought that you would be even more overboard!

The fortuitous encounter from decades ago was actually linked to the current fortuitous encounter. The power of the Advanced Luck Glow was terrifying.

Compared to Harrison and Nero, who mainly relied on him, Han Xiao felt that Fu Ding's self-reliant Luck Glow was more impressive.

Furthermore, not only did he obtain a fortuitous encounter, but his teammates also benefited … It was not in vain that he touched you first and treated you as the chief mascot!
